title: Malmgren's research on Thomas Townsend Brown and time travel

tellings.quote: Harold said he was engaged in deep research around the mid-century anti-gravity inventor Thomas Townsen Brown.

plain: A former presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren is said to have been deep into research on Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor of the mid-1900s who worked on anti-gravity. Michels relays this from what Malmgren told him. It matters because it would tie a high-level government insider to the hunt for craft that defy gravity.
